mechanism: Albendazole may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing tramadol metabolism and increasing risk of seizures and serotonin syndrome; tramadol also lowers seizure threshold while albendazole is associated with CNS effects.
action: Monitor for increased tramadol adverse effects including seizures, dizziness, and serotonergic symptoms; consider alternative analgesic if possible or use lowest effective tramadol dose with close clinical observation.
